n-k-k10-04.title: Isaziso esisodwa, omakhelwane ababili
n-k-k10-04.topic: Ukufinyeza isaziso esisemthethweni ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa yimikhawulo yaso
n-k-k10-04.goal: Thola umugqa wesifinyezo oshintsha umkhawulo wesikhathi wesaziso, bese ubhala kabusha isaziso engxoxweni yeqembu lomakhelwane nanjengesikhumbuzo esikhulunywayo kumakhelwane osekhulile, ugcine usuku, amahora nesakhiwo kunembile.
n-k-k10-04.material:
Ihhovisi lokuphatha lithumele isaziso. Uhlala ku-101동.

[단수 안내]
배관 점검 공사로 10월 25일 토요일 오전 9시부터 오후 2시까지 101동 전 세대의 물이 나오지 않습니다. 공사가 일찍 끝나면 물이 먼저 나올 수 있습니다. 단수 전에 필요한 물을 미리 받아 두시기 바라며, 공사 후 처음 나오는 물은 누런색일 수 있으니 잠시 틀어 둔 뒤 사용하시기 바랍니다.
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.prompt: Umakhelwane wenze izifinyezo ezine ezimfushane zesaziso. Iyiphi eshintsha incazelo?
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.hint.0: Phinda ufunde isaziso bese ulandisa amaqiniso aso (nini, kuphi, yini okufanele kwenziwe). Bese uqhathanisa isifinyezo ngasinye nohlu lwakho.
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.hint.1: Funa noma yimuphi umushwana owenza isikhathi side, sifushane noma sishiyeke kakhulu kunalokho isaziso esikushoyo.
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.r.a: Lokhu kugcina usuku, amahora nesakhiwo ngokunembile njengoba isaziso sinjalo.
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.r.b: Isaziso sithi amanzi angabuya ngaphambili uma umsebenzi uphela ngokushesha.
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.r.c: Isaziso sithi amanzi okuqala ngemuva komsebenzi angaba ngephuzi futhi kufanele aphume isikhashana.
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.explain: I-'하루 종일' yelula ukucisha kwamahora ayisihlanu (9:00-14:00) kube usuku lonke, okungenza abantu bacabange kabi.
n-k-k10-04.s.s2.prompt: Bhala umlayezo omfushane (imisho engu-2-3) weqembu lengxoxo lomakhelwane ngesiKorea, nge-해요체 enobungane. Gcina usuku, amahora, isakhiwo neseluleko ngamanzi kunembile.
n-k-k10-04.s.s2.hint.0: Landisa amaqiniso amane okufanele aphile: nini, kuze kube nini, ubani othintekayo, yini okufanele ukwenze kuqala.
n-k-k10-04.s.s2.hint.1: Phinda uchaze elilodwa ngalinye nge-해요체 enobungane bese ushintsha amagama aqinile esaziso ngamagama engxoxo.
n-k-k10-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe umakhelwane ofunda umlayezo wami kuphela angazi ngqo ukuthi amanzi ayeka nini nakuphi?
n-k-k10-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uzwakala njengengxoxo phakathi komakhelwane, hhayi njengesaziso?
n-k-k10-04.s.s3.prompt: Uhlangana nomakhelwane osekhulile ku-elevator. Sho iphuzu elibalulekile emshweni owodwa noma emibili ekhulunywayo ngesiKorea, ngenhlonipho (honorific). Gcina usuku, amahora neseluleko.
n-k-k10-04.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngokuthi umakhelwane ngenhlonipho (어르신, 할머니, 할아버지 ...).
n-k-k10-04.s.s3.hint.1: Sebenzisa i--(으)세요 noma i--(으)시- kulokho umakhelwane okufanele akwenze, futhi ugcine amahora emafushane.
n-k-k10-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ngingakhuluma kanje nomuntu omdala engimhloniphayo?
n-k-k10-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe umakhelwane angakwenza ngalokhu kuphela (usuku, amahora, ukulungiselela amanzi)?

n-k-k10-01.title: Ubani okushilo, futhi kanjani ngokuqinile?
n-k-k10-01.topic: Inkulumo ebikiwe: ukunikeza futhi namandla esimangalo
n-k-k10-01.goal: Qhathanisa isifinyezo somfundi nerekhodi lokuqala lokulalelwa, uthole imigqa ebika kabi isikhulumi, uqambe uhlobo loshintsho, bese ubhala kabusha umugqa owodwa ngaphandle kokuhlanekezela.
n-k-k10-01.material:
Umfundi wephephandaba lesikole wafinyeza ukulalelwa komphakathi. Ngezansi amazwi ncamashi ezikhulumi bese kuba isifinyezo somfundi.

[간담회 발언 기록] 주제: 전통시장 주차장 유료화
박 시장: "내년 3월부터 시범 운영을 검토하고 있습니다. 아직 확정된 것은 아닙니다."
김 상인회장: "유료화되면 손님이 줄어들까 걱정입니다. 첫 30분은 무료로 해 주셨으면 합니다."
이 교수: "다른 도시에서는 유료화 후 주차 회전율이 높아졌다는 연구가 있습니다. 다만 상인 매출에 미친 영향은 도시마다 달랐습니다."
n-k-k10-01.thinking.1: Ukuqaphela ushintsho endleleni isimangalo esenziwe ngayo ngamandla
n-k-k10-01.thinking.2: Ukubhala kabusha umbiko ukuze uhlale uthembekile
n-k-k10-01.prereq.1: Wazi inkulumo ebikiwe (-다고 했다) ne--(으)ㄹ까 걱정이다
n-k-k10-01.s.s1.prompt: Imigqa emibili yesifinyezo somfundi ayihambisani nalokho okushiwo yisikhulumi esibizwe ngegama. Khetha eyodwa yayo (noma iyiphi iyabalwa).
n-k-k10-01.s.s1.hint.0: Thatha umugqa ngamunye bese uthola umuntu oqanjwa kurekhodi.
n-k-k10-01.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa isimangalo emugqeni nemisho yalowo muntu: ngumangalo ofanayo, osishiwo ngumuntu ofanayo?
n-k-k10-01.s.s1.hint.2: Uma umugqa ubonakala uhambisana, wubeke eceleni komusho wamarekhodi okuvela kuwo bese uqhathanisa igama negama.
n-k-k10-01.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 2 uguqula ukukhathazeka kwenhloko yabathengisi ('줄어들까 걱정입니다') ube isibikezelo esimsulwa ('단언했다'). Umugqa 5 unikeza isikhulumi sicwaningo kuyisikhulumi sedolobha. Imigqa 1, 3, 4 no-6 ihambisana nerekhodi.
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.prompt: Imigqa emibili iyaphutha. Yiziphi izincazelo EZIMBILI ezifanele lokho okwaphutha kuyo?
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.hint.0: Chaza inkinga yomugqa ngamunye oyiphutha ngenkulumo eyodwa ngaphambi kokubheka izinketho.
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.hint.1: Nquma ngenketho ngayinye ukuthi yenzeka emugqeni owukhethile noma akukho nowodwa.
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.r.b: Imigqa yomibili eyiphutha igcina izinombolo (3월, 30분) njengoba zazinjalo; ukuhlanekezela kuseduze kwenye indawo.
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.r.d: Isicelo semizuzu engu-30 ekhululekile sibikwa njengesicelo ('요청했다') emugqeni 3, okulungile.
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.explain: Umugqa owodwa unikeza inkulumo yocwaningo yeprofesa kumengameli wedolobha; omunye uthuthukisa '걱정입니다' ube umphumela oqinisekile.
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.prompt: Bhala kabusha umugqa oyiphutha ngenhloko ye-상인회장 ukuze ubike amazwi akhe ngaphandle kokuhlanekezela. Bhala ngesiKorea (isitayela sezindaba, isib. -다고 말했다) noma ngesiNgisi.
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qala umusho ngomuntu oqanjwa yirekhodi, bese usho ukuthi lowo muntu wazizwa noma wacela ini.
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.hint.1: Khetha isenzo noma isiphetho esihambisana ne-'ngiyakhathazeka ukuthi...' kunokuthi 'kuzokwenzeka'.
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Isenzo sami noma isiphetho sibonisa ukukhathazeka kunokuqiniseka?
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: I-상인회장 ingayifunda imisho yami ithi 'yebo, yilokho engikushilo'?
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.model.2: The head of the merchants' association said he was worried that fewer customers might come.

n-k-k10-02.title: Yimaphi amaslothi okuzijwayeza asinda yonke imithetho?
n-k-k10-02.topic: Isaziso esinegatshana lokuhlukile: ukuthola zonke izinketho ezivumelekile
n-k-k10-02.goal: Funda isaziso sendlu yeklabhu esinomthetho wesikhathi sokugcina, ikhefu lasemini, ukuvalwa ngempelasonto nokuhlukile kwesikhathi sokuhlolwa, uthole amaslothi amathathu okuzijwayeza ezinsukwini ezihlukile alandela yonke imithetho, bese ucela elilodwa ngesiKorea.
n-k-k10-02.material:
Namuhla ngu-10월 10일, 월요일. Iqembu lakho lomculo lifuna ukubhukha indlu yeklabhu namuhla.

[동아리방 사용 안내]
1. 사용 신청은 사용일 3일 전까지 받습니다.
2. 사용 시간은 오전 10시부터 오후 8시까지이며, 한 팀이 한 번에 쓸 수 있는 시간은 3시간 이내입니다.
3. 낮 12시부터 오후 1시까지는 점심시간이므로 사용할 수 없습니다.
4. 토요일과 일요일에는 문을 열지 않습니다.
5. 단, 시험 기간인 10월 17일부터 19일까지는 사용할 수 없습니다.

밴드 친구의 문자: "우리 공연이 22일이라 21일까지는 연습을 끝내야 해요. 연습은 한 번에 2시간 이상 해야 하고요."
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.prompt: Isimo 1 sithi izicelo ziyavalwa izinsuku ezintathu ngaphambi kosuku lokusetshenziswa. Uma usebenzisa namuhla (ngomhla we-10), yiziphi izinsuku zokusetshenziswa ezivunyelwe?
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.hint.0: Buza: ngosuku luni lokusetshenziswa 'namuhla' kungamathathu ngqo izinsuku ngaphambili?
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi usuku lwakamuva lwenza isicelo sibe sesidlule noma sakamuva kunesikhathi sokugcina.
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.o.a: Umhla we-13 noma noma yimuphi umhla wakamuva
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.o.b: Noma yimuphi umhla kuze kube we-13
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.r.b: Lokho kuphendula isiqondiso: umthetho umisa usuku lokuqala ongabhukha ngalo, hhayi lokugcina.
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.r.c: '-까지' inikeza umkhawulo, hhayi usuku olulodwa ncamashi; izinsuku zakamuva ziyavunyelwa nazo.
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.o.d: Umhla we-7 noma noma yimuphi umhla wakamuva
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.r.d: Lokho kubala izinsuku ezintathu emuva kusukela namuhla, kodwa umthetho ubala kusukela osukwini lokusetshenziswa.
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.explain: Ukusebenzisa ngomhla we-10 kungamathathu ngqo izinsuku ngaphambi kwe-13, ngakho umhla we-13 uyisikhathi sokuqala sokusetshenziswa, futhi izinsuku zakamuva nazo ziyasebenza.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.prompt: Thola amaslothi okuzijwayeza angu-3 ezinsukwini ezihlukile ezingu-3 ezanelisa isaziso nombhalo womngani weqembu. d = umhla ku-Okthoba, s = ihora lokuqala ewashini lamahora angu-24 (오후 2시 = 14), t = amahora okuzijwayeza.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ikhalenda kusukela umhla we-10: yimuphi umhla osuku ngalunye lweviki? Umhla we-10 ngoMsombuluko.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.hint.1: Qala ngokuwela izinsuku (ngokushesha kakhulu, kamuva kakhulu, ngempelasonto, okuhlukile), bese ukhetha amahora.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.hint.2: Hlola iwashi ekugcineni: qala ngo-10 noma kamuva, qeda ngo-20, gcina 12-13 ikhululekile, futhi ube ngamahora angu-2-3 ubude.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Kusheshe kakhulu: isikhathi sokugcina sesicelo singu-3 izinsuku ngaphambi kosuku lokusetshenziswa.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.fail.c5: Isilothi siqala ngokushesha kakhulu noma siphela ngemva kwesikhathi sokuvala.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.fail.c6: Ukuzijwayeza kumele kube okungenani amahora angu-2 futhi iklabhu ivumela amahora angu-3 ngokuphezulu.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.explain: Izinsuku ezine kuphela ezisebenzayo: umhla we-13 nowe-14 (Thu, Fri) kanye nomhla we-20 nowama-21 (Thu, Fri). Umhla we-15-16 ungempelasonto, we-17-19 uyisikhathi sokuhlolwa (okuhlukile), we-12 usheshe kakhulu, futhi owama-22 usewuphuzile kakhulu. Ngosuku ngalunye amahora kumele agweme isidlo sasemini futhi ahlale phakathi kuka-10:00-20:00.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha ISILOTHI ESISODWA sakho bese ubhala umlayezo omfushane ngesiKorea (ohloniphekile) kumphathi wendlu yeklabhu ucela sona. Nikeza usuku nesikhathi.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Vula ngesibingelelo noma usuku, bese ubonisa ibanga lesikhathi.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Phetha ngesicelo esihloniphekile esinjenge--고 싶습니다 noma 신청합니다.

n-k-k10-03.title: Isitolo singasenqaba lokhu kubuyiselwa kwemali?
n-k-k10-03.topic: Imithetho enokuhlukile: iliphi iqiniso elinquma icala
n-k-k10-03.goal: Thola ukuthi liyiphi iqiniso eliphelele elilodwa eliqinisa isicelo sokubuyiselwa kwemali ngaphansi komthetho onokuhlukile, sho lokho okungashiwo kakade, futhi ucele iqiniso elishodayo ngenhlonipho ngesiKorea.
n-k-k10-03.material:
Imithetho yokubuyiselwa kwemali yesitolo nesicelo sekhasimende.

[환불 안내]
1. 구매일로부터 7일 이내에 신청하시면 환불해 드립니다.
2. 포장을 뜯었거나 사용한 상품은 환불이 되지 않습니다.
3. 단, 상품에 불량이 있는 경우에는 구매일로부터 30일 이내에 포장이나 사용 여부와 상관없이 환불해 드립니다.

[주문 내역] 무선 이어폰 1개 / 구매일: 10월 3일
오늘은 10월 12일입니다. 손님: "이어폰이 생각보다 별로예요. 환불해 주세요."
n-k-k10-03.thinking.2: Ukuphendula kuphela ukuya lapho amaqiniso evumela
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.prompt: Wena uyisisebenzi. Yiliphi iqiniso ELISODWA elishodayo elingashintsha ukuthi ukubuyiselwa kwemali kungenzeka yini?
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ngokubala ukuthi sekudlule izinsuku ezingaki kusukela ekuthengeni futhi uqhathanise nomthetho wokuqala.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.hint.1: Bese uthola umthetho ongasasiza ikhasimende bese ubona lokho okudingayo.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.o.a: Ukuthi ikhasimende likhokhe ngekhadi noma ngemali.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.r.a: Imithetho ayisho lutho ngokuthi ikhasimende likhokhe kanjani.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.r.b: Umkhawulo wezinsuku ezi-7 usudlulile, ngakho iphakethe elivaliwe ngokwalo alizuzi imbuyiselo, futhi umthetho 3 ushaya indiva iphakethe noma kunjalo.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.r.d: Irekhodi lomyalelo sekuvele likhombisa usuku lokuthenga, futhi imithetho ayicele irisidi.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.explain: Kubalwa kusukela ku-10월 3일, namuhla ngusuku lwesi-9, ngakho umthetho 1 awusasebenzi. Umthetho 3 kuphela ongaphinda unikeze imbuyiselo, futhi kuncike ekutheni kukhona yini isiphambeko.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.prompt: Ngokususelwa kulokho okwaziwayo manje kuphela, umabhalane angasho ini ngokufanele?
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.hint.0: Hlukanisa lokho amaqiniso asekuxazululile kulokho akushiya kuvulekile.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola inketho ngayinye ukuthola iqiniso elengeza icala elingakaze lishiwo, noma umthetho elishiya.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.a: Imbuyiselo ingenzeka, ngoba isicelo siphakathi kwezinsuku ezi-7.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.r.a: 10월 3일 kuya ku-10월 12일 ziyizinsuku ezi-9, edlula umkhawulo wezinsuku ezi-7.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.b: Imbuyiselo yokushintsha umqondo idlule umkhawulo, kodwa umkhiqizo onesiphambeko usengafaneleka.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.c: Imbuyiselo ayinakwenzeka nganoma yiliphi icala, ngoba izinsuku ezi-7 sezidlulile.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.r.c: Lokhu kushaya indiva umthetho 3, onikeza izinsuku ezingu-30 uma kunesiphambeko.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.d: Imbuyiselo ingenzeka kuphela uma iphakethe lisengavulwanga.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.r.d: Iphakethe elingavulwanga libalulekile phakathi kwezinsuku ezi-7 kuphela; ngemuva kwalokho, akukho emithethweni enikeza imbuyiselo yomkhiqizo ongavulwanga.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.e: Imbuyiselo ayinakwenzeka, ngoba mhlawumbe iphakethe lavulwa.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.r.e: Akukho ecaleni okusho ukuthi iphakethe lavulwa; lokhu kuyisiqagelo.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.explain: Umabhalane angasho lokho okulandela emaqinisweni: akukho mbuyiselo yokungawuthandi nje umkhiqizo ngemuva kwezinsuku ezi-7, kodwa impendulo ingashintsha uma umkhiqizo unesiphambeko.
n-k-k10-03.s.s3.prompt: Phendula ikhasimende ngesiKorea (ngenhlonipho). Sho ukuthi umkhawulo wezinsuku ezi-7 usudlulile kwimbuyiselo yokushintsha umqondo, bese ubuza into eyodwa osadinga ukuyazi ngaphambi kokuba ukwazi ukunquma.
n-k-k10-03.s.s3.hint.0: Qala unikeze isizathu kumthetho wokuqala, kafushane futhi ngenhlonipho.
n-k-k10-03.s.s3.hint.1: Bese ufunda kabusha imithetho emithathu futhi ubuze ngeqiniso icala elisalithiyile.
n-k-k10-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ngichaza ukuthi kungani impendulo ingesona yebo okwamanje?
n-k-k10-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe umbuzo wami ubuza iqiniso elilodwa elinquma icala?

n-k-k10-05.title: I-'yebo' eyayisho cha
n-k-k10-05.goal: Buyekeza ukufunda kwakho kwe-네 yodwa ngemuva kombuzo onegethivu njengoba ingxoxo ikhombisa ukungaqondani, khetha indlela ecacile yokuphendula, bese ulungisa ukungaqondani ngesiKorea.
n-k-k10-05.material: Usebenza enkampanini. Inhloko yomnyango wakho (부장님) ikubuza ngomhlangano wakusasa. Nobabili nikhuluma ngenhlonipho.
n-k-k10-05.thinking.0: Ukubona ukuthi impendulo emfushane ingafundwa ngezindlela ezimbili
n-k-k10-05.thinking.1: Ukubuyekeza ukufunda uma kuvela impendulo yomunye umuntu
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.prompt: Funda ingxenye ngayinye bese ukhetha ukufunda okubonakala kunokwenzeka kakhulu ngaphambi kokuqhubeka.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.hint.0: Nquma usebenzisa kuphela imigqa oyifundile kuze kube manje.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi isikhulumi singabe sivuma ini: umbuzo njengoba ubuzwe, noma amaqiniso?
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.0.after: ESiKoreeni esijwayelekile, i-네 yodwa ivumelana nombuzo njengoba ubuzwe ('네, 안 가요'), ngakho a iyindlela yokufunda ejwayelekile. Ukufunda b yindlela isikhulumi esijwayele i-'yes' yesiNgisi esingasho ngayo. Kunoma yikuphi, i-네 yodwa ayitsheli umlaleli ukuthi yiyiphi.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: I-네 yodwa ayinikezi uphawu lokungabaza; impendulo engenasinqumo ingasebenzisa amagama afana ne-'글쎄요' noma i-'아직요'.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Akukho ku-네 elula okubuzayo lutho; ithoni kumele ikhuphuke futhi umbuzo uzosebenzisa amagama.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Kokubili a no-d kungafaneleka, kodwa i-아니요 ka-나 esheshayo nokugcizelela kukhomba kakhulu ku-a: i-네 yodwa yezwakala njengo-'angiyi' nakuba 나 ayisho ukuthi 'yebo, ngiya'.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.o.a: 부장님 wezwa i-네 njengo-'angiyi'; 나 wayesho ukuthi 'yebo, ngiya'.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 부장님 wezwa i-네 njengo-'uyaya', futhi 나 empeleni akayi.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Umugqa wokugcina ka-나 uthi 가요 no-갈 거예요, ngakho 나 uyaya.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Akekho kubo okhuluma ngosuku noma isikhathi.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.o.d: 나 washintsha umqondo ngemuva kokuthi 부장님 anikeze ukukhulumela wona.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ngokuzayo uma kuvela umbuzo onegethivu, iyiphi indlela yokuphendula egwema le nkinga?
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Ukuphinda isenzo nokuphika kwaso noma ukuvuma kusho iqiniso ngqo, ngakho umlaleli akadingi ukunquma ukuthi i-네 ikhomba ini.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Phendula nge-네 bese uchaza kamuva kuphela uma umlaleli ebukeka edidekile.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ukungaqondani sekuvele kwenzeka ku-네 yokuqala; ukuchaza kamuva kuyalungisa esikhundleni sokuvimbela.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Phendula nge-네 enomsindo omkhulu futhi ecacile kakhulu.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Umsindo awushintshi iqiniso lokuthi i-네 ingezwakala njengokuvumelana nombuzo noma namaqiniso.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Njalo phendula nge-아니요, noma ngabe umbuzo uyini.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ukuhlala usho i-아니요 bekungaphumela empendulweni engalungile noma nini lapho impendulo yangempela ukuthi awuyi.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Sho i-네 noma i-아니요 bese uphinda isenzo: '네, 안 가요' noma '아니요, 가요'.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.reflect: I-네 noma i-아니요 yodwa ngemuva kombuzo onegethivu ('안 가세요?') inamathela kuwo wonke umbuzo, hhayi amaqiniso kuphela, ngakho ingezwakala ngezindlela ezimbili eziphambene. Ukwengeza isenzo ('아니요, 가요') kuvimbela ukungaqondani.
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.prompt: Ngemuva nje kokungaqondani, uthumela 부장님 umlayezo omfushane ngesiKorea (ngenhlonipho) osho ukuthi bewusho ukuthi UYAYA futhi uxolisa ngokudideka.
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.hint.0: Khuluma ku-부장님 bese uxolisa ngokudideka ngomushwana omfushane.
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.hint.1: Sho iqiniso ngesenzo (lokho ozokwenza kusasa), hhayi ngegama lempendulo yodwa.
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe umlayezo wami usho ngokucacile ukuthi ngiyaya?
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngisho iqiniso ngesenzo esikhundleni se-네 yodwa?
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ukuxolisa kwami kunenhlonipho ngaphandle kokuba kude kakhulu?
